description: This Java class, LoanArrearsAgeingUpdateHandler, handles the updating and maintenance of loan arrears ageing details in a Fintech application. It performs database operations such as truncating, deleting, inserting, and updating records related to loan repayment schedules and overdue calculations. The class interacts with other services and utilities to generate SQL queries, process loan schedules, and maintain accurate arrears data for active loans.

classes.name: LoanArrearsAgeingUpdateHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing the update of loan arrears ageing details, including inserting, deleting, and recalculating overdue information based on loan schedules, status, and payments.

classes.name: LoanOriginalScheduleExtractor
classes.description: Inner class implementing ResultSetExtractor to extract loan schedule data from the database for processing arrears and overdue calculations.

methods.name: truncateLoanArrearsAgingDetails
methods.description: Executes SQL to truncate the m_loan_arrears_aging table, clearing existing data.

methods.name: deleteLoanArrearsAgingDetails
methods.description: Deletes existing arrears ageing records for specific loan IDs.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsForAllLoans
methods.description: Resets and recomputes arrears ageing details for all loans, inserting fresh data.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetails
methods.description: Updates arrears ageing details for a specified list of loan IDs, recalculating overdue info.

methods.name: buildQueryForInsertAgeingDetails
methods.description: Constructs SQL insert statement for populating arrears ageing data, optionally for all loans or specific ones.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsWithOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Prepares insert statements considering loans based on their original repayment schedule.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsWithOriginalScheduleForAllLoans
methods.description: Processes all loans to update arrears data based on their original schedule.

methods.name: buildQueryForLoanIdentifiersWithOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Creates SQL to fetch loan IDs that are based on original repayment schedules.

methods.name: getLoanSummary
methods.description: Retrieves summary data of loans, including paid and written-off amounts, for overdue calculations.

methods.name: getScheduleDate
methods.description: Fetches loan schedule details from the database, returning structured schedule data.
